svg.title: Call execution and post-call workflow
svg.desc: One Fargate application process handles live Nova audio and native asynchronous tools. Public provider usage deltas are accumulated once without pricing calls. A single controller verifies farewell playback, performs bounded SDK and telephone cleanup, closes the WebSocket, drains writes and saves analytics. Both the launcher and post-call worker require confirmed telephone completion. A retained workflow saves regional Sonic cost before Twilio Call lookup, Luna extraction and optional AgentCore date resolution. Validated ready intelligence gates follow-up actions; intelligence is saved separately. Workers are process-local, with a dedicated two-thread executor and no durable queue.
svg.text: Call execution and post-call workflow
One ECS Fargate application process · live audio, termination, and retained post-call work
EXECUTION BOUNDARIES
1 WHILE CONNECTED
Strands owns connection recovery and scheduled renewal (420 s default)
Strands BidiAgent + Nova Sonic 2.5
Twilio audio ↔ Nova speech in the existing session
Brief AI introduction → confirm intended person
English, French or Spanish · Nova-only speech
Native asynchronous tools
update_due_record · capture_payment_date_phrase
end_conversation · begin_farewell
Ordered live writes await actual store completion
Call-scoped usage accumulator
Text + audio input/output deltas counted once
Call model + AWS region retained across restarts
No pricing lookup or extra model request
Public receive() captures usage before output fences
2 ONE TELEPHONE LIFECYCLE CONTROLLER
Caller disconnect and SDK failure also converge on cleanup
Closing handshake
Settle tools / writes → begin_farewell readiness
Nova farewell: transcript + audio + response end
Matching Twilio playback mark acknowledged
Bounded telephone cleanup
Close admission → stop SDK → Twilio hangup
Confirm terminal Call status; bounded retry
Close WebSocket; preserve pending write workers
Finalize and save call analytics
Drain admitted writes → save finalized analytics
Persist usage, model, region and termination proof
Launcher + workflow each verify disconnect proof
Confirmed telephone completion + saved analytics admit post-call work
3 RETAINED POST-CALL WORKFLOW
Separate executor: at most 2 blocking operations at once across calls
Calculate + save Sonic cost
Decimal × regional AWS rate snapshot
Persist sonic_cost before intelligence
Partial coverage → observed subtotal
No runtime pricing API or model call
Luna intelligence + date resolution
Twilio Call details → Bedrock Converse (GPT-6 Luna)
Validate extraction + at most one repair request
Date parser → AgentCore Python only on a miss
ready + current call/phrase gate the due-date write
Eligible actions + intelligence save
ready result → payment SMS / dispute / wrong-number action
Persist intelligence, action outcomes and phase status
Dashboard polls stored call details and token costs
Partial / failed extraction skips follow-up actions
Cost failure does not suppress extraction; intelligence failure does not erase saved cost.
Unconfirmed telephone completion: save unresolved analytics; withhold pricing, intelligence and follow-up actions.
Process-local tasks share CPU / memory. A 20 s shutdown grace period is not durable delivery or cross-process exactly-once execution.
Source: sonic_bridge.py · sonic_usage.py · call_lifecycle.py · main.py · postcall_workflow.py · postcall.py
